body_html:
The Marche guest chair brings a refined, design-forward presence to any reception or waiting area, pairing a sleek Italian-style curved plywood back with a comfortably upholstered seat. Standard black metal legs, with optional chrome, brushed chrome, or tungsten finishes, frame a silhouette that looks at home in a clinic lobby, a corporate reception, or a busy waiting room. With 11 coordinating wood stains and open, closed, or upholstered back options, it adapts to virtually any interior scheme.

Features

  • Sleek Italian-style curved plywood back for an upscale, contemporary look
  • Wood back available open, closed, or fully upholstered
  • Standard black metal legs with optional chrome, brushed chrome, or tungsten finishes
  • 11 wood stain finishes to coordinate with Global veneer and laminate furniture
  • Multi-use design ideal for lobbies, waiting rooms, and meeting spaces
  • Complementary bar and counter-height stools available to complete the series

Specifications

Overall dimensions measure 20"W x 21"D x 31.5"H. The Marche exceeds ANSI/BIFMA industry standards and is backed by a limited lifetime warranty on the frame and components, with 5 years on upholstery, foam and mesh. Proudly made in Canada.

A family-owned Canadian supplier since 1964, Brant Business Interiors is an OECM-eligible partner, so Ontario institutional buyers can purchase without an open tender. Request a Quote on Marche guest chairs, or call 1-800-835-9565 to spec your reception or waiting area.
